name: Zappa Open-Source Python Serverless Deployment
free_limit: MIT-licensed Python CLI for packaging and deploying Flask, Django and other Python web apps to AWS Lambda/API Gateway; no software license fee or CLI usage cap.
watch_out: Zappa itself runs locally and is free; AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch and other deployed resources may incur charges and require an AWS billing account/card. Default generated IAM execution policies can be broad; review least-privilege permissions before production.
